_doc: DRAFT serialization-grade ledger. LLM-drafted (extraction only); scoring is deterministic via scripts/serialize_grade.py. Every row is locked:false until Zach reviews. Two opposing passes: taxonomic_claims = Jeben's explicit briefing predictions (deductive/fidelity); emergent_tags = load-bearing signals the OUTCOME surfaced with no briefing parent (abductive/folksonomy/coverage). Orphan emergent tags are the net-new Justin tributaries to fork. Lock by setting locked:true (and correcting verdict/parent) per row, or override with --set.

meta.title: Jeben's Louisville serialization vs. the Justin call

taxonomic_claims.statement: Every LB pain point maps 1:1 onto the ARCS offer as priced; nothing needs re-positioning, only re-activation.
taxonomic_claims.evidence: Justin resonated deeply and co-built a receipt live on his own decision; product fit held without re-positioning (delaney signalThread 'he built one live with real numbers').

taxonomic_claims.statement: Re-entry should lead with a polished, professionally formatted page (presentation quality), not a re-pitch.
taxonomic_claims.evidence: The polished Louisville suite was the artifact of record; the call engaged on substance, not a re-argued pitch.

taxonomic_claims.statement: Jeben has stepped back from the client (reduced standing/patience); weight him lightly, give a forwardable artifact rather than ask him to re-argue in person.
taxonomic_claims.evidence: Reality inverted this FAVORABLY: Jeben actively brokered the call, texted same-day 'he and I will discuss', and widened scope beyond Louisville. His claim was wrong (fidelity miss) but wrong in the good direction (amplifying). Note: the 'widened past Louisville' half was itself anticipated by the Jul-15 briefing's PE/institutional thread — see E4.

taxonomic_claims.statement: The clean re-entry decision is the 'next bag' (mango vs. alternatives); one free studio session on THAT decision converts the record into a first receipt.
taxonomic_claims.evidence: The MECHANISM held (one live decision -> a co-built receipt) but the REFERENT diverged: the decision Justin actually operated was the national sales-team vendor tripwire ($12K/mo, October gate), not the mango bag.

taxonomic_claims.statement: Best case: Justin commits an hour, a receipt + $2-5K pretest lands inside the funding window, and a Medium pilot ($10K/mo, two lanes) starts with board visibility.
taxonomic_claims.evidence: No pilot started and no pretest was commissioned; the thread parked behind a stated focus gate.

taxonomic_claims.statement: Base case: one no-cost studio session first, tier decision deferred until Justin holds the receipt.
taxonomic_claims.evidence: This is essentially what happened: a working session, a receipt in hand, decision deferred. Base case is playing out.

taxonomic_claims.statement: Worst case risk: timing stays wrong (family, or the round/Yokai consume all attention); do not chase.
taxonomic_claims.evidence: A binding timing gate did materialize ('heads-down on Japan, let's just focus on this') even though engagement was warm; the constraint the worst case gestured at is real, though the cause (Japan JV) was named more specifically by reality.

taxonomic_claims.statement: The Jul-10 'underused-capacity / next-bag (mango)' framing is stale — the live decision has moved off the mango bag.
taxonomic_claims.source: 2026-07-15-jeben.json thread TRACKER_NOW_STALE (line 74) + scenario C 'Louisville closes for real' (line 130)
taxonomic_claims.evidence: HELD: the live decision Justin operated was the sales-team tripwire (delaney line 44), not the mango next-bag, so the 'next bag is no longer the live decision' call is confirmed and supersedes T3's referent. (Counter-signal, folded not scored: the same Jul-15 framing's pessimistic 'highest-leverage entry may have passed' diverged — engagement was warm, the entry had not passed.)

taxonomic_claims.statement: The Louisville plant is closing (manufacturing moving to Wisconsin, ~20 layoffs) — the fact Jeben chose to lead with.
taxonomic_claims.evidence: The plant closure never surfaced in the Justin call — delaney.json does not mention it. Reality did not test this prediction, so it is unaddressed (not a fidelity miss, not a confirm). Carry it into the next touch as an open, load-bearing fact.

emergent_tags.tag: The sake / seimaibuai connoisseur wedge is the resonance channel
emergent_tags.outcome_evidence: Justin is a serious sake/whiskey connoisseur with a Japan contract-distilling angle; the register that lands is constructive interference (seimaibuai, no false binaries), not pitch. Absent from the briefing entirely.

emergent_tags.tag: The real job-to-be-done is emotional: candid outside read without looking weak
emergent_tags.outcome_evidence: 'It'd be nice to know what the objectivity is based on' — objectivity vs. emotion, a candid outside read that doesn't cost face. The briefing framed fit as feature/pain-point mapping, not this emotional job.

emergent_tags.tag: Buyer self-served the product live on his OWN numbers
emergent_tags.outcome_evidence: Justin operated ARCS himself, building a tripwire with his own figures — stronger than the briefing's predicted 'demo the mango decision for him'. The strongest product signal, and it was on a decision the briefing didn't name.

emergent_tags.tag: The camera/focus moment — he chose the slow lane against his own default
emergent_tags.outcome_evidence: He said he had skipped video because he planned to work on the Japan JV while half-listening ('I usually do two things at once') — yet on the call he chose focus instead. The product's promise (structure over distracted instinct) happened live. NOTE: 'multitask' is ARCS's summary word, not his; do not quote it as his. Not anticipated by either briefing; also a caution (the slow lane is not his default).

emergent_tags.tag: Champion self-initiated a new academic lead-gen funnel (the genuinely-new sliver)
emergent_tags.outcome_evidence: Jeben broadened ARCS beyond Louisville, confirmed by same-day text. The STRUCTURAL 'widen past Louisville into larger/better-funded orgs' half was NOT a blind spot — the Jul-15 briefing already carried it as a self-initiated PE/institutional thread (parent). Only the specific academic-lead-gen-funnel angle is genuinely new; that narrow sliver is the orphan. Re-parented so the one champion event is not double-charged (it was already penalized once as T2 diverged).
